The paler marginal zone cells in part disrupt follicle mantles with follicular colonization (<<31866>>). At low magnification, an organoid architecture with follicles and pale, markedly expanded interfollicular areas is seen (<<31869>>). Hyperplastic follicles resembling progressive transformation of germinal centres with expanded paler marginal zones; some reactive germinal centres are also still present (<<31877>>). CD20 stains follicles and perifollicular and interfollicular B cells (<<31870>>). IgD-positive mantle cells penetrate the germinal centres that are infiltrated at the periphery by marginal zone cells (<<31871>>). Remnants of reactive germinal centres are highlighted by the presence of CD10-positive B cells (<<31872>>) and BCL2-negative B cells (<<31873>>). Residual germinal centres contain abundant PD1+ T cells (<<31874>>).
